decisions.reason: The iOS size requirement already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording external streaming instead of bundling the video.
The How-To delivery requirement already has a complete same-message MODIFY setting video_delivery_method to external_streaming.
Choosing external video streaming does not change Android language coverage, localization priority, or full-app localization scope.
The video delivery choice does not alter required right-to-left layout behavior.
External streaming for the How-To video does not change Android OS compatibility, deprecated-API refactoring, or maintainability requirements.
Choosing external video streaming does not change iOS language coverage, localization priority, or full-app localization scope.
The source changes how the video is delivered, not the required Bend, Align, and Measure instructional sequence.
External video streaming does not change the policy to remove unused Android permissions or the identified READ_PHONE_STATE permission.
The How-To video delivery decision does not affect whether social-media links resolve correctly.
External streaming for the How-To video does not change iOS framework modernization or deprecated-API refactoring requirements.
The source decision concerns How-To video delivery and does not change localization of social-media links.
The external streaming choice does not alter the requirement to provide an iOS Privacy Manifest.
